versions.changelog: v2.2.0: adapted to the platform's free testing period (from 2026-10-18) — after registering, one-click login lands directly on the home page and every feature is usable without payment; subscription payment is now an optional membership upgrade; if the user clicks the login link but lands on the subscription page (testing period ended), the flow automatically switches to the payment path. Scripts unchanged.
v2.1.0: PayPal subscriptions are now agent-managed; scripts/powpow-register.mjs adds --provider alipay|paypal; SKILL.md, payment-and-activation.md, agent-flow.md and README.md updated to match.
v2.0.1: bundle the 6 product screenshots inside the skill (assets/screenshots/) so they work without external image hosting, incl. environments where GitHub is unreachable
v2.0.0: sync with the Chinese main package - agent-assisted mode (script powpow-register.mjs), Alipay subscription handling, dual-link one-click login, new agent-flow reference
Localize display name; align search keywords with per-language translations; add categories

- Initial release of powpow-register: your guide to registering and activating a PowPow (Bubble) account.
- Includes product introduction with screenshot tour, step-by-step registration walkthrough, and support for common registration or activation issues.
- Guides users through verification, troubleshooting field errors, and moving from account creation to subscription activation.
- Handles both standard registration and third-party login options (Google, Watcha, Huawei account).
- Purely guidance-based: no handling of user credentials or direct actions in registration/payment flows.
- Designed to be user-first, with clear next-step prompts and a conversational support experience.
